content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler cereal, multigrain, dry is a ready‑to‑serve product for infants from 6 months old, containing a blend of whole grains (oats, rice, wheat, corn) and often fortified with vitamins and minerals. The cereal easily dissolves in warm water or milk, creating a smooth, easily digestible porridge.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The multigrain blend provides a wide range of nutrients from different cereals.
The product is typically free of added sugar, supporting healthy taste development.
It is often fortified with iron, calcium and B‑vitamins to support growth and development.
The dry format is convenient for travel and does not require refrigeration.
Manufacturers may use micro‑encapsulation technology to preserve sensitive vitamins.

items.title: Rich in fiber
items.content: Fiber from whole grains supports healthy digestion and regular bowel movements in toddlers.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Iron is essential for hemoglobin formation and helps prevent anemia during early development.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6 and folate aid energy metabolism and nervous system development.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Support the formation of strong bones and teeth, especially during rapid growth periods.

items.title: Low in added sugar
items.content: Reduces the risk of developing a sweet preference and helps maintain stable blood glucose levels.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: Some children may be sensitive to wheat, oats or corn; introduce the product gradually.

items.title: Iron excess
items.content: Frequent consumption of iron‑fortified foods can lead to excess intake, so follow pediatric guidance.

items.title: Not suitable for infants under 6 months
items.content: The infant digestive system is not yet ready for whole grains; start with specialized milk formulas.

items.title: Temperature control
items.content: Prepare the cereal to a warm (not hot) temperature to avoid oral burns.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 2–3 tablespoons of dry cereal with 150–200 ml of warm water, breast milk or formula. Stir thoroughly, let stand for 1–2 minutes, then check the temperature. You can add fruit or vegetable puree for extra flavor and nutrition.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry cereal in its original sealed package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the package tightly closed to prevent moisture and loss of aroma.
